rules.title: Forbidding the Algorithmic Inflation of Rent (FAIR) Act
rules.requirement: Landlords and software providers are prohibited from using algorithmic devices that process other landlords' nonpublic competitive data to set, recommend, or coordinate rental prices, lease terms, or occupancy levels.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to residential rental property owners and 'coordinators' (software providers/other parties) using algorithmic devices with competitively sensitive information from multiple landlords.
rules.exemptions: Excludes spreadsheets operating without AI requiring human analysis, and databases that only query unprocessed data; also excludes certain publicly available rent estimation tools, traditional listing databases, and government-administered affordable housing programs per secondary source.
rules.penalty: Civil penalties; existing remedies under the New Jersey Antitrust Act preserved; AG enforcement via complaint portal.
rules.quoted_span:
“Algorithmic
device” means a device that uses one or more algorithms to process or otherwise
perform calculations of data, including, but not limited to, data concerning
rental prices, material lease terms, or occupancy levels.

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether a government housing/affordability-control program applies to the unit

rules.conflict_note: Secondary source (Day Pitney) states effective date July 1, 2027, consistent with official bill text's enactment note of approval July 20, 2026; no conflict but effective date sourced from secondary coverage as official chunk did not include that specific line.
